newsitem.title: EGYPT: EGYPT POUND RATES RISE IN TIGHT MARKET.
newsitem.headline: EGYPT POUND RATES RISE IN TIGHT MARKET.

text.p: Overnight rates on the Egyptian pound rose in a tight private sector market on Sunday to between 8-7/8 and 9-3/4, from between 7-1/2 and 8-1/2 percent on Thursday, bankers said.

"The market is shorter than it normally is at this time of the week because there's a fresh t-bill auction on Tuesday and everyone is trying to exceed their position in the Central Bank," one banker said.
The market is traditionally tight on Sunday, the first day of the business week.
Average one-week rates also increased to between nine and 9-1/4 percent, compared to 7-7/8 and nine percent on Thursday, bankers added.
